seasonalNotes: Tropical year-round: 25–32°C, high humidity. Monsoon Nov–Jan. Afternoon thunderstorms common. Haze Aug–Oct. Always carry umbrella.

personas.name: Singapore Work Day
personas.description: Lives in Toa Payoh, works in Raffles Place CBD. Kopi at the kopitiam, MRT to office, hawker lunch at Lau Pa Sat, FairPrice groceries on the way home.

stops.title: Kopi-o kosong at the kopitiam
stops.description: Uncle's stall at Blk 75. Say 'kopi-o kosong'.
stops.action: Order a kopi-o kosong; using a reusable cup may be eligible for a discount.
stops.context: Morning rush—arrive before 8 for a seat.
stops.wellbeing: Limit sugar for a healthy start.
stops.motivation: A good coffee powers your day!
stops.transition: Walk to Toa Payoh MRT for your commute.
stops.feedback: Did this coffee tip help you start your day?

stops.title: EZ-Link balance — top up if <$5
stops.description: Check at the gantry. Top up at GTM if needed.
stops.action: Check your EZ-Link balance and top up at the GTM if needed.
stops.context: Morning queues can be long at the top-up machines.
stops.wellbeing: Keep your bag zipped and valuables secure.
stops.motivation: A topped-up card means a smooth commute!
stops.localization: GTM machines accept cash and cards.
stops.transition: Board the MRT to Raffles Place.
stops.feedback: Did this tip help you avoid delays?

stops.title: 9 AM standup — bring charger
stops.description: Battery was low yesterday. Don't forget again.
stops.action: Pack your charger and check your battery before the meeting.
stops.context: Office WiFi can be spotty—download files in advance.
stops.wellbeing: Sit with good posture during meetings.
stops.motivation: Preparedness leads to a productive day!
stops.transition: Head to Lau Pa Sat for lunch.
stops.feedback: Did this meeting tip help you today?

stops.title: Hawker lunch — Lau Pa Sat
stops.description: Chicken rice or laksa. Go at 11:30 to beat the queue.
stops.action: Try chicken rice or laksa. Bring cash for faster payment.
stops.context: Lunch rush starts at noon—arrive early for a seat.
stops.motivation: A good lunch keeps you energized!
stops.transition: Return to Toa Payoh after work.
stops.feedback: Did this lunch tip help you enjoy hawker food?

stops.title: FairPrice — eggs, bread, milo
stops.description: Check the app for promo prices.
stops.action: Check your shopping list and scan the FairPrice app for deals.
stops.context: Evenings are busy—shop quickly to avoid crowds.
stops.wellbeing: Carry reusable bags to reduce plastic waste.
stops.motivation: Smart shopping saves money and time!
stops.transition: Head to Tiong Bahru Market for dinner.
stops.feedback: Did this shopping tip help you today?

stops.title: Dinner at Tiong Bahru Market
stops.description: Chwee kueh + carrot cake. Tapao extra for tomorrow.
stops.action: Order chwee kueh and carrot cake. Tapao extra for tomorrow.
stops.context: Dinner rush starts at 7—arrive early for a seat.
stops.motivation: End your day with a local favorite!
stops.transition: Plan your route home or to your next stop.
stops.feedback: Did this dinner tip help you enjoy your meal?

personas.name: Singapore Sightseeing
personas.tagline: Gardens, Marina Bay, and street food
personas.description: Tourist day: Gardens by the Bay, Marina Bay Sands SkyPark, Little India lunch, Chinatown, Orchard Road, and Clarke Quay drinks.

stops.title: Gardens by the Bay — Supertree Grove
stops.description: OCBC Skyway opens at 9. Bring water — humid!
stops.address: Gardens by the Bay, Marina Gardens Dr
stops.action: Arrive early to avoid crowds. Bring water and a hat.
stops.context: Humidity is high—dress in light clothes.
stops.wellbeing: Stay hydrated and take breaks in the shade.
stops.motivation: Start your day with nature and fresh air!
stops.localization: Signage in English and Chinese. Toilets available.
stops.transition: Walk to Marina Bay Sands for the SkyPark.
stops.feedback: Did this garden tip help you enjoy your visit?

stops.title: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
stops.action: Buy your ticket online to skip the queue. Bring your camera.
stops.context: Best views are before noon—less haze.
stops.wellbeing: Use sunscreen on the SkyPark deck.
stops.localization: Audio guides available. Staff speak English.
stops.transition: Take the MRT to Little India for lunch.
stops.feedback: Did this SkyPark tip help you enjoy the view?

stops.title: Lunch at Tekka Centre — Little India
stops.description: Biryani + murtabak. Cash only at some stalls.
stops.action: Try biryani or murtabak. Bring cash for payment.
stops.context: Lunch rush starts at noon—arrive early for a seat.
stops.motivation: Enjoy the flavors of Little India!
stops.transition: Take the MRT to Chinatown for your next stop.
stops.feedback: Did this lunch tip help you enjoy Little India?

stops.title: Chinatown Heritage Centre
stops.action: Buy your ticket at the entrance. Explore the exhibits at your own pace.
stops.context: Afternoons are quieter—good for a relaxed visit.
stops.wellbeing: Take breaks in the air-conditioned galleries.
stops.transition: Take the MRT to Orchard Road for shopping.
stops.feedback: Did this museum tip help you enjoy Chinatown?

stops.title: Orchard Road shopping
stops.description: ION Orchard or Takashimaya. Cool off in the AC.
stops.action: Shop for deals at ION or Takashimaya. Take a break in the food court.
stops.context: Orchard Road is busiest after 5 PM.
stops.wellbeing: Stay hydrated and rest your feet.
stops.motivation: Treat yourself after a day of sightseeing!
stops.localization: Most shops accept cards and mobile payments.
stops.transition: Take the MRT to Clarke Quay for evening drinks.
stops.feedback: Did this shopping tip help you today?

stops.title: Evening drinks — Clarke Quay
stops.description: Riverside bars. Laser show across the water at 8 PM.
stops.action: Find a riverside table and enjoy the laser show at 8 PM.
stops.context: Evenings are lively—arrive early for a good spot.
stops.motivation: End your day with a relaxing view!
stops.localization: Most bars accept cards and mobile payments.
stops.transition: Plan your route back to your hotel or home.
stops.feedback: Did this evening tip help you enjoy Clarke Quay?
